title: Concept: Permissions-Policy grants a Privacy Sandbox API to every origin
description: Wildcard allowlists for advertising and attribution APIs let every embedded frame enrol the page in audience measurement. The operator loses the ability to name which third party observes the user, which is the control these APIs are supposed to give back.
applicability: Responses that send Permissions-Policy on pages embedding third-party frames.
risk: Third-party frames can register the page in interest groups or attribution flows, so user measurement happens through a party the operator never named.
